name: eca-reel-editor
description: Ecommerce Academy Reel Editor — drop a raw talking-head clip into Claude Code and get back a finished vertical reel or Meta video ad in your own brand: cleaned audio, filler words cut, captions and graphics that match what you say, plus product, review and offer cards from your Shopify store. Brand comes from brand-intelligence's brand-data.md (no interview); products, reviews and reel logging come from EcomOS when connected. Runs on your Mac — footage never leaves your computer. Built on Nicola Pocock's claude-reel-editor (MIT).
